terms.definition: The amount of energy needed to raise the temperature of 1 kg of a substance by 1 °C.
terms.examiner: ΔE = m c Δθ. Units J/kg °C.

terms.definition: The rate at which energy is transferred or the rate at which work is done.
terms.examiner: P = E/t or P = W/t. 1 watt = 1 joule per second.

terms.definition: A power of one joule per second.
terms.examiner: A 100 W motor transfers 100 J every second.

terms.definition: Two motors lifting the same load: the more powerful one does it faster.
